purpose: Electron desktop cockpit for driving Claude Code CLI sessions — Terminal + config/observability/scheduling tabs, organized around a TAB→operations-root→EPIC→session hierarchy, with a mobile web mirror at bilko.run.
what: The app's core domain model is **TAB** (a project cwd) containing **EPIC**s (`PromptSession`s, each a 1:1 tagged `claude` session with `agentType`/`tag` axes) which author **PRD**s run by the `scheduler`. Recent work landed the **Agent + Mission** two-axis grounding for New Epic creation (`NewEpicCard.tsx`, `lib/epicIntake.ts`, `lib/groundingBoard.ts`), made `AgentLibrary.tsx`/`TagLibrary.tsx` full CRUD editors, and retired the `feedback/` folder in favor of `status: 'proposed'` Epics filed via `/propose-epic`.

Persistence lives under `<cwd>/session-manager-operations/` governed by a **single-writer law** (`opsOwnership.cjs`) — each namespace (`prompt-sessions`, `scheduler`, `project-brief`, `browser`, `bilko-host`) has exactly one owning writer, fail-closed. The `scheduler.cjs` runs PRDs as `claude -p` jobs capped at 3 concurrent (session slot pool), with boot-reconciliation, a dead-process reaper, and a definition-of-done gate at queue-drain.

Four **active Epics** are in flight: `Project Home Redesign` (bug — wiring the Component Library into the generate pipeline), `Design Agents, Missions and the Develop Skill` (discussion — how `/develop` relates to the new Agent+Mission grounding), `Bilko.run Integration` (feature — a new left-nav tab to publish projects like the Marketing Page to bilko.run via an agent), and `Session Manager Operations - Maintain` (feature — a sweep protocol, now landed as the `ops-sweep` skill, to clean redundant content across projects' `session-manager-operations/` folders).

Git history shows heavy recent churn on Epic/Agent/Scheduler UX: two-axis picker, grounding board, agent title/department grouping, `bilko-host` publishing wiring, `/develop-eagerness` skill routing surfaced in Epics, and `ops-maintenance-protocol` doc contradictions resolved. Version is at v0.57.0 (frequent `/builder` release cycles).

scope.text: session-manager-operations/feedback/ fully retired; proposed Epics (status: 'proposed') replace the feedback-file intake pipeline entirely
No general OWNERS namespace under session-manager-operations/ — skill-authored docs folders (architecture/, HUMAN_LEARN/, etc.) stay outside the fail-closed write-ownership check by design
Agent (persona, who) + Tag (mission, what) two-axis grounding for Epic creation, with a read-only grounding-board inspector (AIM framework: Actor/Input/Mission)
AgentLibrary.tsx / TagLibrary.tsx are no longer read-only directories — full CRUD editors with live-refresh on cross-edits
ops-sweep skill added as the portable implementation of the ops-maintenance-protocol audit

conventions: Single-writer law over session-manager-operations/<namespace>/ — fail-closed, exceptions only via a declared delegation table
Zustand stores never cross-subscribe; compose via component selectors
Never return a freshly-built value from a zustand selector (React #185 blank-app risk) — three prior incidents
Cap concurrent claude -p jobs at 3 machine-wide (OOM incident 2026-06-10)
No CommonJS in renderer, no ES modules in main process .cjs files
Epic title/goalText fixed for session lifetime — never repurpose, start a new Epic instead
Every Epic is born 'proposed'; nothing is created directly as 'active'
